title: Long distance, but make it stars
old_caption: Missed calls and goodnights that land at lunch: different time zones can make love feel lonely. A shared plan helps a lot. Distance is easier with a date circled on the calendar.

title: The earth signs plan a date.
old_caption:
Planning a first date like it's a quarterly review?
The earth signs learn to plan a little less and feel a little more.

title: The Elders.
old_caption: When it feels like everyone is coupled up except you, panic is easy. There's no deadline on love. You're not late. You're on your own time, and that's allowed.

title: Stuck.
old_caption: Stuck between floors with your crush, both waiting for the perfect moment. Sound familiar? The plan with the sunset and the violin can wait. The honest sentence works right now.

title: First Date Escape Room.
old_caption: A first-date escape room where every lock needs a real answer. Opening up can feel scarier than any puzzle. But closeness starts when you let someone see a true piece of you.

title: The Ex Files.
old_caption: Three hours studying an ex's sunset post is a heavy way to spend a night. The real case worth opening is you. Closure won't show up on their profile. It grows when you start living your own life again.

title: Once Upon a Star.
old_caption:
The prince only knew the gown. The neighbor loved the messy bun and popcorn version. It's a fairy tale with a softer ending.
Find someone who loves the sweatpants you, not just your best night out.

title: The stars' rules for fighting fair
old_caption:
Three gentle rules for disagreeing: skip "you always," stick to one topic, and take a break when it gets too hot.
Fight the problem, not each other. Save this for the next tough talk.

title: The fire signs group chat.
old_caption:
Ever get so excited about someone you forget to ask about them?
The fire signs learn that passion listens too.

title: The First Fight.
old_caption:
A forgotten fork, a late arrival, a tone. Small things add up fast in a first fight.
When you remember you're on the same side, it becomes you two against the problem, not each other.
